# AIScrubber

> A zero-telemetry browser-local privacy desk, developer CLI, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) server engineered by Poorvith M P (https://poorvithmp.com).

## Core Capabilities
- **Image Metadata Cleaner**: Detects and removes supported EXIF/GPS, PNG text, and C2PA-compatible image metadata markers in local memory. It does not verify cryptographic signatures or identify issuers.
- **Unicode Cleaner**: Removes selected invisible characters, Tag Plane tokens, variation selectors, unusual spaces, and confusables. Optional literal phrase rules clean copy. Findings do not identify a source model or prove a vendor watermark.
- **Text & Incident Log Scrubber**: Replaces sensitive emails, API keys, Bearer tokens, IP addresses, payment cards, and customer IDs with numbered tokens ([EMAIL_1], [SECRET_1]).
- **Prompt Enhancer & Roundtrip Anonymizer**: Masks secrets into {{API_KEY_1}} constants and restores original values from AI-generated responses using local session keys.
- **Visual Media Redactor**: Interactive HTML5 Canvas tool for Gaussian Blur, Pixelation, and Blackout redactions on images and screenshots.

## Technical Guarantee
Content processing occurs in browser memory or local Node.js CLI processes. The website loads Google Fonts and a public GitHub star count without including user content. Session mapping files contain original values and must stay private.

## Developer CLI & MCP
- Run standalone via NPX: `npx aiscrubber clean-watermarks <file>`, `npx aiscrubber scrub <file>`, `npx aiscrubber mask <prompt>`, `npx aiscrubber unmask <response> --key <key.json>`.
- MCP server command: `npx -y aiscrubber mcp`.
